ctx.x: That's when I had the offer to go to Europe. Gale's office called. They wanted to break a ban of 30 years, that had existed with the two unions, the English union and the American one. I don't even know what happened. It seems some English musicians came over here and they wouldn't allow them off the beat to play.
I don't know. I heard something, so I got ready to leave to go to England. I had turned down offers before and I decided to go.
